I have a small plot, so I will manage it carefully and intensively rather than spread effort across more crops. For wheat, I will use an improved variety, keep fertilizer moderate but sufficient, irrigate a few key times, and use rotary tillage because it is efficient for my scale and works well on this land. After wheat harvest, I will plant hybrid maize on the same 1.5 mu because hybrid maize gives me stronger yield potential, and with well irrigation I can support it through the summer. I will keep pesticide use controlled but not excessive, aiming to protect yield without wasting money. My goal is stable output from both seasons, not gambling on extreme input levels.
